description: Apply the Fisher equation, (1 + nominal) = (1 + real) * (1 + inflation), to solve for whichever of the nominal rate, inflation rate, or inflation-adjusted real rate is missing, given exactly two of the three (all as percents).

inflationRatePercent.description: Annual inflation rate as a percent

nominalRatePercent.description: Nominal (stated) annual rate as a percent

realRatePercent.description: Inflation-adjusted real rate as a percent

name: calculate_real_rate_of_return
